deliverables.direction: elevated oblique camera, diagonal bodily lean over roulette, challenging upward glance, asymmetrical cape, tight private-duel staging
prompts:
Create a completely NEW cinematic illustration of this same adult male casino dealer for loading background #2. The attached approved image is ONLY an identity, costume and painting-style reference. Reuse the distinctive black-and-silver long hair, side-part fringe, red eyes, facial identity, white shirt, ruby/black cravat, ruby brocade waistcoat, spade-shaped ruby brooch, gold chains and embroidered black velvet cape with red lining. Everything about the CAMERA, BODY POSE, SILHOUETTE, EXPRESSION and staging must be newly directed. Do not trace or preserve the reference's front-facing standing bust, open inviting palm, raised fan of cards, level table, symmetrical curtain framing or face angle. No cards in this image.

ART DIRECTION: "THE LAST SPIN" — an intense private roulette duel, an overhead cinematic moment rather than a posed character poster. Wide 16:9 landscape, polished painterly anime casino artwork. Camera is distinctly ABOVE the table at about a 40-degree downward angle, close enough to see the roulette surface. The dealer is leaning bodily forward over the wheel, torso rotated diagonally and shoulders at visibly unequal heights; the slanted shoulders, bent elbows, draped cape and long hair create a new strong diagonal silhouette. His face stays approximately horizontally centered in the upper-middle region, seen in a convincing three-quarter upward glance toward the elevated viewer. He has a narrow, amused challenging smile and focused eyes, not the gentle welcome of the reference.

A huge crafted roulette wheel curves diagonally across the lower foreground, showing red-and-black pockets, a small ivory ball, polished brass spindle and radial wood grain. His nearer hand is planted naturally on the table edge to support his lean, the other hand is poised above the roulette with a tiny ivory ball held delicately between thumb and index finger. Complete believable arms and hands, correct anatomy. His hair spills over one shoulder with gravity; the cape is pulled asymmetrically across his back and arm, not spread like the reference's triangular cape. Use perspective consistently so the body visibly interacts with the wheel. The important costume details stay recognizable.

The setting is a secluded midnight casino room viewed from above: dark peacock-blue carpet, a partial arc of a burgundy chair, dark wood and brass fixtures at the outer edges. A narrow cool moonbeam and a single warm side lamp create a dramatic diagonal light divide; face and knuckles are warmly lit, with teal-blue shadows and sharp roulette highlights. No cathedral window backdrop, no matching pair of chandeliers, no generic symmetrical casino hall. Restrain ornament so the dynamic pose and the roulette duel tell the story.

Keep the full crown of hair and both hands completely inside the canvas with comfortable safe margins. The dealer remains large and is the central focal subject. The lower 15–18% fades naturally into calm near-black plum shadow, reserved for a separate loading label. NO readable text or numbers, no logos, no loading letters, no interface, no progress bar, no frame or watermark. One complete newly composed illustration, not a collage and not a background replacement under the same pose.

Make one precise framing refinement to this roulette illustration. Preserve the same dramatic overhead camera angle, diagonal leaning body, looking-up expression and SAME face, roulette wheel, hands holding the ivory ball and bracing on the rail, exact ornate outfit, asymmetrical cape, lighting and room. Do NOT convert it back into a frontal portrait or change its unique composition.

The top of the hair is currently clipped by the upper canvas edge. Reframe the scene just enough to show the COMPLETE crown and all top hair tips with about 5% of image height of visible dark patterned carpet behind/above the highest hair. Pull the virtual camera back by about 7% and slightly lower the whole arrangement within the same WIDE 16:9 canvas. Retain the large compelling face and figure, the same elevated viewpoint and diagonal roulette foreground. All hair, complete hands, ivory ball, and central roulette spindle remain fully visible. Keep the lower dark plum fade for a separate loading wordmark. No new props, no changes to costume, anatomy or identity, no text, signs, border, UI or watermark.

deliverables.prompt:
Create a completely NEW cinematic illustration of this same adult male casino host as loading background #3. The approved attached image is ONLY the character identity, rich costume and painterly-anime style reference. Preserve the black-and-silver long hair, distinctive side part, red eyes, recognizable face, white shirt, ruby/black cravat, black-and-ruby brocade waistcoat, ruby spade brooch, fine gold chains and black velvet cape with embroidered gold edges and wine-red lining. Do NOT reuse or trace the reference's camera, frontal portrait, shoulder line, stationary bust silhouette, open palm or raised cards. Do not simply replace the background. This must look like a different deliberately directed scene from the same visual novel.

ART DIRECTION: "THE CURTAIN RISES" — a commanding, theatrical arrival caught mid-step. Wide 16:9 landscape. Dramatic LOW camera from the foot of a short grand staircase, looking upward at a confident, centered protagonist. Medium-long upper-thigh-up composition with the full head safely visible and at least 7% margin above the highest hair; keep the actor large. His torso is turned decisively in a three-quarter direction, weight moving through a step down toward us, one shoulder forward and the other behind. His face turns back toward the viewer with a lifted chin and a poised, slightly mischievous smile. The low-angle face, posture and body silhouette must be visibly different from a frontal welcoming host or someone bending over a gambling table.

One hand reaches UP and OUT to pull a heavy crimson velvet curtain aside, with that arm creating a strong rising diagonal toward an upper side corner; keep the full hand and fingers inside the frame. The other hand lightly catches the edge of his own cape at his waist. His cape sweeps diagonally outward behind the opposite side in a grand flowing S-shaped arc, showing the rich red lining and coherent gold embroidery. Long hair and fabric follow this same movement naturally. No cards, no chip held toward the camera, no reaching palm, no front gaming table blocking the body. Correct human anatomy, two connected believable arms, no extra limbs.

The casino setting is an extravagant SECRET THEATRE ENTRANCE: a near dark curtain close to the camera on one side, a gilded curving staircase with art-deco rails sweeping away on the other side, a glimpse of jewel-toned gaming rooms and tiny elegant casino tables far below in depth. The spatial composition is asymmetrical even though the actor remains near horizontal center. Strong warm amber stage backlight outlines his hair and cape; soft warm light reveals the face, white shirt and jewelry; deep burgundy and plum shadows supply depth. Make the stair perspective and towering architecture unmistakably low-angle. A dramatic diagonal beam and curling fabric guide our eyes to him, not a symmetrical backdrop of repeated chandeliers. No floating cards, falling coins, confetti shower or ornamental halo crown.

The bottom 15–18% dissolves naturally into quiet near-black plum stage shadow for a separate loading label, without a panel or hard border. The action and all important costume details remain above that calm area. No readable text, letters, signs, logos, loading word, progress bar, UI, frame, collage or watermark. One beautifully staged stand-alone illustration with a unique overall silhouette and visual story.
